title: tanacetum argyrophyllum var. subvirescens
intro: Tanacetum argyrophyllum var. subvirescens, commonly known as Mountain Tansy, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) and a variant of the Tanacetum argyrophyllum plant. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relieving digestive issues, reducing fever, and calming the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tansy include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Mountain Tansy include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and medicinal properties.
